subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Should this issue remain paired to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067 until that PR is rebased and live-proven, or should maintainers replace/close that PR and use another canonical fix path?
rationale: The issue has an open same-author candidate PR with closing syntax, while current main and the latest release already include partial recovery behavior but not enough live proof to close the exact tab-switch interruption report.

options.title: Keep paired and require proof
options.body: Keep this issue open while the linked PR is rebased or rewritten against current main and gains redacted live Dashboard tab-switch/reconnect proof.

options.title: Replace with maintainer-owned fix
options.body: Close or supersede the linked PR only after a maintainer-owned current-main replacement is open, proof-positive, and covers this issue's exact behavior.

options.title: Close after current-main proof
options.body: If maintainers can live-prove that current main already covers the full tab-switch/interruption scenario, close this issue as implemented with source and release provenance.

recommendation.title: Keep paired and require proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while the linked PR is rebased or rewritten against current main and gains redacted live Dashboard tab-switch/reconnect proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice spans current Control UI state recovery and Gateway active-run session contracts, where recent current-main history points to this owner for routing.
